# pve_apt_repositories (Resource)

APT repository configuration of a node (singleton): create adds a standard repository by handle (PUT), update toggles enabled at path+index (POST).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_apt_repositories" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the repository should be enabled or not.
- `handle` (String) Handle that identifies a repository.
- `index` (Number) Index within the file (starting from 0).
- `path` (String) Path to the containing file.

### Read-Only

- `errors` (Attributes List) List of problematic repository files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--errors))
- `files` (Attributes List) List of parsed repository files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
- `infos` (Attributes List) Additional information/warnings for APT repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infos))
- `standard_repos` (Attributes List) List of standard repositories and their configuration status (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--standard_repos))
